text: Android: leave-list / revoke-invite silently no-op when offline

Context: confirmLeave's best-effort-then-unconditional-local-cleanup was
intentionally copied from AuthRepositoryImpl.logout() (A9/T-18). But the two are
semantically different — logout SHOULD always succeed locally (you're ending your
own session), whereas leave/revoke need server confirmation. So fix leave/revoke
here, but do NOT "consistency-fix" logout() the same way; its always-local-wipe
is correct.

Done in 005c7c0. confirmLeave + revokeInvite now require a confirmed response: only
local cleanup / member-refresh after 2xx (or 404 = already done); IOException/other
-> keep state + "You're offline; try again when connected" via the existing
errorMessage the screen already renders. Followed note#1 precisely: did NOT touch
logout()'s always-local-wipe (correct there). Tests updated — the old
"confirmLeave still cleans up locally even if unreachable" test asserted the exact
zombie-delete this fixes, so it's now inverted (keeps list + errors); added 404-
cleans-up and offline-revoke-errors. Verified green.
